verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's official CLI documents `debug-files upload` for native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF), which covers the dSYM and native parts of the story. ProGuard mapping uploads are not mentioned. No doc or hands-on report confirms that uploaded symbols actually turn mobile or native crash frames into function names and lines. The general Sentry-compatibility claim does not specifically establish symbolication. Missing for 10: ProGuard/Android mapping file support, documented server-side symbolication behavior for native/mobile stack traces, independent or hands-on corroboration.
